items.content_text:

From our flat, we often hear trucks going past and loud noise from the ventilation system several storeys below.
But as we got ready for work at 8am on Thursday we heard something unusual – “bang, bang, bang”. It was gunfire, and it sounded like it was right outside our apartment.
Soon after, we heard fire alarms, police sirens…
